name: Westfield Century City
description: Westfield Century City is a premier luxury shopping destination in the heart of Los Angeles, featuring an expansive open-air design with high-end retailers, gourmet dining options including Eataly and Din Tai Fung, and entertainment venues like AMC Theatres. The center underwent a major redevelopment and offers an upscale shopping experience with flagship stores from Nordstrom, Bloomingdale's, and exclusive boutiques like Tiffany & Co., Aritzia, and Alo Yoga.
demographics: Affluent urban and suburban shoppers in West Los Angeles, including Beverly Hills, Century City, and surrounding neighborhoods. High-income professionals, entertainment industry workers, and international visitors.
summary: A luxurious open-air shopping center in West Los Angeles featuring upscale retailers, gourmet dining, and entertainment in a modern, redesigned environment.
